entry.title: Resolution 475 (2024-2026) (Hawaiʻi County): — → Adopted
entry.content:
AUTHORIZES AND DIRECTS THE DIRECTOR OF FINANCE TO NEGOTIATE THE DISPOSITION OF CERTAIN REAL PROPERTY BY LEASE TO NONPROFIT ORGANIZATIONS FOR PERMANENT HOUSING PURPOSES

Authorizes the negotiation of eight one-year leases with four one-year renewal options at an approximate annual cost of $10 for eight residential properties to be used as long-term permanent housing for underserved populations.

Status: — → Adopted

Latest action: Council: Adopts Res. 476-26, Draft 2 & FC-136 - 04/22/26
